# Valyd — Identity & Verify API Documentation

> Valyd has two separate integration paths in one SDK. **Login with Valyd** uses OIDC and reads a
> signed-in user's account through `valyd.auth`. **Verification** (Hosted Verification, through
> `valyd.verify`) runs in two lanes: **Managed by Valyd** — the user signs in and you run a hosted
> session with their `valyd_access_token`, where every check is available (ID/KYC, liveness, face
> match, age, professional license, face uniqueness, location) and passed proofs save to their
> Valyd ID; and **Verify Fresh** — no login, no account, liveness + face-uniqueness + anti-spoof
> only, hosted or as direct API calls, with the result returned to you. Verification calls need an
> App API key. Everything runs through the Valyd IdP host. This file is the machine-readable index
> of the docs.
> Every page below is available as clean Markdown at the linked `.md` URL — fetch those directly;
> do not try to scrape the HTML site (it is a client-rendered SPA and returns no static content).

## How to integrate (decision flow)

Ask the developer these questions, in order; each answer pins one path + credential + one `.md`
page to fetch and follow. Credentials must be supplied by a human (see "Human-only steps") — never
guess them.

- Q0 (context only): Existing app or starting fresh? Tells you where the login button and keys go.
- Q1 — Team/workforce you onboard AND control (add members, gate who can log in, assign roles)?
  - YES → **Organizations**. Members join by face-activation, then sign in with Login with Valyd;
    roles owner/admin/developer/member; the `valyd_org_member_id` claim (a `vmem_…` id) tells you
    who logged in; unlimited verifications on a per-active-member monthly plan (14-day trial;
    current price → https://docs.valyd.work/docs/organizations/billing.md).
    Credential: `client_id` + `client_secret` (login) + Members API (`X-Client-Id`/`X-Client-Secret`).
    Fetch: https://docs.valyd.work/docs/organizations.md
  - NO → continue.
- Q2 — Just read or verify a user who signs in with Valyd (read their existing proofs, or add a
  check that saves to THEIR account)?
  → **Reusable Identity (with the user's token)**. Read proofs free; run a check with the token and
    the passed proof saves to their Valyd ID; PII stays with Valyd.
    Credential: OIDC Bearer `valyd_access_token` (from Login with Valyd).
    Fetch: https://docs.valyd.work/docs/user-token.md
- Q3 — Run verification checks? Two lanes — pick by login + which checks:
  - "The user signs in / I want proofs on their account, or I need ID/KYC, face match, age,
    professional license, or location" → **Managed by Valyd**: the user signs in, you run a hosted
    session with their `valyd_access_token`, and EVERY check is available (ID/KYC, liveness, face
    match, age, professional license, face uniqueness, location). Passed proofs save to their Valyd
    ID; PII stays encrypted with Valyd; you get the decision + reusable proofs (never raw PII).
    `sessions.create({ workflowId, valydAccessToken, redirectUrl })`.
    Credential: App `X-API-Key` + `workflow_id` + the user's `valyd_access_token`.
    Fetch: https://docs.valyd.work/verify/managed.md
  - "One-off, no login, I only need liveness / uniqueness" → **Verify Fresh**: no Valyd account,
    the liveness + face-uniqueness + anti-spoof family ONLY, on Valyd's hosted page OR as direct API
    calls (`POST /api/v2/liveness`, `/api/v2/face-uniqueness`, `/api/v2/antispoof`). The result
    returns to your system; nothing is saved to a Valyd account. Credential: App `X-API-Key`.
    Fetch: https://docs.valyd.work/verify/standalone.md
  NOTE: ID/KYC, face match, age, professional license, and location are no longer self-serve direct
  checks — they run ONLY through Managed by Valyd (a signed-in user's hosted session).
- Q4 — Login only (sign the user in, run no check)?
  → **Login with Valyd** (OAuth2/OIDC). Credential: `client_id` + `client_secret`.
    Fetch: https://docs.valyd.work/docs/overview.md
- Q5 — Want it all in one flow (user signs in AND you run several checks on Valyd's hosted UI, with
  proofs saved to their account)? That IS **Managed by Valyd**:
  `sessions.create({ workflowId, valydAccessToken, redirectUrl })`.
    Credential: App `X-API-Key` + `workflow_id` + the user's `valyd_access_token`.
    Fetch: https://docs.valyd.work/verify/managed.md

Then clarify (as relevant), fetching the named `.md`:
- Which checks? ID/KYC, liveness, face match, age (age *bands* like `is_18_plus`, never the DOB),
  professional license, location/EVV presence, anti-spoof, face uniqueness (one-person-one-account
  dedup). → https://docs.valyd.work/verify/types.md
- Reusable identity (KYC-reuse)? Save the passed check as a proof — that's **Managed by Valyd**
  (needs the user's `valyd_access_token`). A one-off **Verify Fresh** liveness/uniqueness check
  saves nothing. → https://docs.valyd.work/docs/user-token.md
- Result delivery? Async signed webhook (Managed by Valyd, or Verify Fresh hosted) vs synchronous
  API response (Verify Fresh direct). → https://docs.valyd.work/verify/webhooks.md
- Need RAW identity data (DOB, document number, address)? Requires the consent flow (the user
  approves on their device); otherwise you get proofs / verified-status only.
  → https://docs.valyd.work/docs/request-data.md
- Login scopes? profile (legal name, country, verified status), verifications (proofs/badges),
  email, doctor_license. → https://docs.valyd.work/docs/scopes.md
- Professional license check? Runs through **Managed by Valyd** (a signed-in user's hosted session);
  the name comes from the account and the verified badge saves to their Valyd ID.
  → https://docs.valyd.work/verify/managed.md
- Drop-in button or your own OIDC library? "Sign in with Valyd" button
  (https://docs.valyd.work/docs/overview.md) vs any OIDC library via discovery
  (https://docs.valyd.work/docs/oidc.md).
- Credentials source (IMPORTANT): a human creates the app + keys in the Developer Portal
  (dev.valyd.work); an agent CANNOT mint `client_id`/`client_secret`/API key/`workflow_id` — pause
  and ask, never guess. → https://docs.valyd.work/docs/create-project.md
- Billing? Organization = unlimited verifications on a per-active-member monthly plan (billing
  starts the moment a member face-scans); standalone/non-org = pay per check. Current price + trial
  → https://docs.valyd.work/docs/organizations/billing.md

Full narrative version of this tree (with example calls and the two golden rules) is the Agent
Integration Guide, rendered at https://docs.valyd.work/ai/agent-guide.

## Instructions for AI agents

- Fetch pages with `curl -sL <url>`; each `.md` is self-contained (prerequisites, steps,
  verification, and common errors).
- **Base URLs (one canonical host per product — use these exactly):**
  - Valyd ID / OAuth / OIDC (API host): `https://idp.valyd.work`
  - Verification API (same host): `https://idp.valyd.work`
  - Developer Portal (human sign-in, projects, keys): `https://dev.valyd.work`
  - Documentation (this site, `.md` + OpenAPI): `https://docs.valyd.work`
- **There is NO password login.** Human sign-in to the Developer Portal is passwordless — an emailed
  magic link OR face ("Login with Valyd"). Never look for, store, or send a password. Portal sign-in,
  linking a face, and switching accounts are human-only steps an agent cannot perform.
- **Credentials cannot be created via API.** A human must sign up and generate them in the portal
  (see "Human-only steps" at the bottom). Pause and request these values rather than guessing:
  `client_id`, `client_secret` (Valyd ID); App `API key`, `workflow_id`, webhook signing secret
  (Verification APIs).
- Auth is not interchangeable: Login/account endpoints use an OIDC Bearer access token;
  Verification API calls use `X-API-Key: <App API key>`. An account-connected verification uses
  the App API key plus the signed-in user's `valyd_access_token` in the documented request field.
- Token exchange and webhook signature verification MUST run server-side (never expose the client
  secret or webhook secret to a browser).
- **Machine-readable API specs (OpenAPI 3.1):** for endpoint discovery, schemas, and codegen, fetch
  `https://docs.valyd.work/openapi/valyd-id.json` and `https://docs.valyd.work/openapi/valyd-verify.json`.
- **Capability matrix (machine-readable):** to pick a path deterministically, fetch
  `https://docs.valyd.work/agent/capabilities.json` — a JSON array mapping each real goal to its
  `path`, `product`, `auth`, `credential`, `billable`, `pii_mode`, `saves_proof`, and the `.md`
  `doc` to follow (Login, account-read, account-connected verify, standalone, hosted, organizations).

## Valyd ID — Getting started

- [Overview](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/overview.md): When to use OIDC login, what it reads from an account, and when to use Verification API instead.
- [Create a Project & Get Credentials](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/create-project.md): Dev-portal setup — sign up, create a project, set redirect/scopes, copy client_id + client_secret. (Human-only.)
- [Quickstarts — Login with Valyd](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/quickstarts.md): Stack-by-stack complete logins — Node.js, Next.js, Python, PHP (Laravel), cURL, or any OIDC library — each a full working OIDC flow (state comparison, code exchange, userinfo). (The old /docs/quick-start.md is a compatibility redirect to this page.)
- [OIDC session security](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/login-sessions.md): Store and validate state, nonce, PKCE, and redirect URI as one server-side transaction.

## Valyd ID — Authentication & integration

- [Authentication (OAuth2 / OIDC flow)](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/authentication.md): Authorization URL, state/nonce CSRF, callback handling, code→token exchange, refresh rotation.
- [OpenID Connect (OIDC) Integration](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/oidc.md): Discovery endpoint, manual config, Mendix setup, claim/user mapping, testing, troubleshooting, security.

## Valyd ID — Reference

- [API Reference (endpoints)](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/endpoints.md): OIDC discovery, authorize, token, JWKS, UserInfo, licenses, and account verification proofs under `/api/auth/oidc`.
- [OAuth2 Scopes](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/scopes.md): profile, verifications, doctor_license, zkp, mcp — what data each unlocks and how to request them.
- [Errors & troubleshooting](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/errors.md): Every error code with cause and fix, plus the app-level "state mismatch" CSRF rejection.
- [Changelog](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/changelog.md): @valyd/sdk release history, including the v1.10.1 secure OIDC transaction helpers.


- [Request user data (consent)](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/request-data.md): Ask a Valyd user for raw attributes (legal_name, dob, country). The user approves in their Valyd app; values return end-to-end encrypted (X25519 sealed box) via valyd.auth.requestAttributes + getAttributeResult. Needs libsodium-wrappers for self-custody.

## Verification APIs — Guides

- [Introduction](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/intro.md): The two lanes — Managed by Valyd (signed-in, all checks, proofs) vs Verify Fresh (no login, liveness/uniqueness) — and data handling.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/quickstart.md): Get an App API key and run a Verify Fresh liveness check or a hosted session.
- [Developer Portal](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/console.md): Apps, API keys, workflows, webhooks, SSO. (Human-only UI steps.)
- [Choose an integration](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/modes.md): Decide between Managed by Valyd (signed-in user, all checks, proofs on their account) and Verify Fresh (no login, liveness/uniqueness returned to you).
- [Managed by Valyd](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/managed.md): The signed-in lane — sign the user in, run a hosted session with their token; every check is available and passed proofs save to their account.
- [Hosted delivery](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/hosted.md): The Valyd-hosted capture page used by both lanes — signed webhooks, decision API, statuses, and optional account linking.
- [Verify Fresh (standalone)](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/standalone.md): No-login liveness + uniqueness + anti-spoof — overview, idempotency, and SDK quick start. Per-endpoint pages: [Liveness](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/standalone/liveness.md), [Anti-spoof](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/standalone/antispoof.md), [Face uniqueness](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/standalone/face-uniqueness.md), [Raw HTTP (cURL)](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/standalone/http.md), [Common errors](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/standalone/errors.md). (ID/KYC, face match, age, professional license, and location run only through Managed by Valyd.)
- [Node SDK](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/sdk.md): Install/init @valyd/sdk, resources, types, error handling, Express webhook handler.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/webhooks.md): Register a callback URL and verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures over the raw request body.
- [Statuses & decisioning](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/statuses.md): Every session/check status, what it means, and how to act on it.

## Verification APIs — API Reference

- [API Reference](https://docs.valyd.work/verify/api-reference.md): Sessions, Workflows, Verify Fresh checks, Decision, and Errors & rate limits. All calls use `X-API-Key`.

## API specs (OpenAPI 3.1)

- [Valyd ID OpenAPI](https://docs.valyd.work/openapi/valyd-id.json): OIDC login and account-resource endpoints, schemas, auth, and errors.
- [Verification APIs OpenAPI](https://docs.valyd.work/openapi/valyd-verify.json): Sessions, Verify Fresh checks, credentials, and the verification webhook (HMAC-SHA256). Use for SDK/codegen and endpoint discovery.

## Downloads & tooling

- [Postman collection](https://docs.valyd.work/valyd-postman-collection.json): Importable collection of the Valyd ID API requests.
- [Node SDK starter](https://docs.valyd.work/downloads/valyd-sdk-starter.zip): Starter scaffold for integrating Valyd.


## Developer portal — accounts, organizations & teams

- [Developer accounts & sign-in](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/developer-accounts.md): Passwordless sign-in (emailed magic link or face / Login with Valyd — there is NO password), connecting a Valyd face identity to an email-only account, and how one identity can own several console accounts (one per company) with an account switcher. Human-only portal actions.
- [Organizations & teams](https://docs.valyd.work/docs/organizations.md): Individual vs organization accounts, the owner/developer/member roles, shared apps, public vs private apps, adding a workforce by face, and one-account billing.

## Human-only steps (an agent must pause and request these)

- Sign up for a Valyd account and log in to the Developer Portal: https://dev.valyd.work (no KYC required).
- Create a Valyd ID project; copy `client_id` and `client_secret` (secret shown once — regenerate if lost).
- Register the exact redirect/callback URL on the project (must match what you send; no trailing slash).
- Sign in to the Developer Portal (https://dev.valyd.work) with Valyd SSO; copy the App API key (shown once).
- Create a Verify workflow and copy its `workflow_id`; set the webhook URL and signing secret.
